idea-plugin.name: Zero-Trust Enterprise Secret Guardian
idea-plugin.description:
Zero-Trust Enterprise Secret Guardian

Eliminate security risks associated with leaked sensitive data (API keys, database access, cloud certificates) during local application development.

  • ✓ Authenticate to Infisical and Doppler cloud vaults.
  • ✓ Environment Picker to instantly switch between Dev, Staging, Prod.
  • ✓ Dynamic Run Configuration Interception to inject secrets in memory without writing to disk.
  • ✓ Pre-Commit Scanner Guardrail to block committing known vault secrets.
  • ✓ Log Masking to censor injected secrets in terminal and IDE application logs.
